## The experience

Section heading: Entertainment your guests will remember

Intro: From the flower girl to grandpa, everyone gathers around — laughing, cheering, and walking away with a little something to keep.

Occasions served: Weddings · Engagements · Birthdays · Anniversaries · Corporate · Galas

### 01 Effortless joy — A moment that brings everyone together

There's a magic in the crowd that forms around the machine — the cheers when the claw drops, the gasps, the shared laughter. It's the kind of candid delight your photographer will love.

We tuck it beautifully into your floor plan so it complements your décor, never competes with it.

### 02 Keepsakes, not clutter — Prizes your guests actually treasure

We stock the machine with curated, high-quality plush toys — the kind of keepsake guests genuinely want to take home. A sweeter, more memorable alternative to the usual party favour.

Custom themes and colours available to match your palette.

## Collections

Section heading: Thoughtful, all-inclusive collections

Every collection includes the machine, premium plush prizes, a booth attendant, and full delivery & setup. Tell us about your event and we'll tailor a quote to match.

### Premium

- For: Intimate gatherings

### Signature

- For: Full-scale events

- Priority date booking
- Pricing: on enquiry

### Bespoke

## Our story

Section heading: A sweeter way to celebrate

Jubilee Bee began with a simple belief: the most joyful celebrations are the ones where everyone gets to play. We bring a beautifully styled claw machine — stocked with premium plush prizes — right to your venue.

Based in British Columbia, we serve Metro Vancouver, Vancouver Island and beyond, handling every detail from delivery to breakdown so you can stay fully in the moment.

With love, Jubilee Bee

## Common questions

Section heading: Frequently asked

Everything you need to know before booking your claw machine experience.

### What areas do you serve?

We serve Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby and Victoria, plus Vancouver Island and events anywhere in British Columbia — including destination events further afield. Travel arrangements can be made for locations across the province.

### How far in advance should I book?

Most couples book us 6 months to a year ahead of their wedding date. Popular dates fill up quickly, so reaching out early gives you the best chance of securing your preferred date.

### What’s included in each collection?

Every collection includes the machine, premium plush prizes, a professional booth attendant, delivery, setup, and breakdown. The Signature collection adds unlimited plush prizes and priority date booking; Bespoke is fully tailored to your event.

### Do you handle delivery and setup?

Yes — full delivery, setup, and breakdown are included with every collection. We typically arrive 1–2 hours before your event starts to get everything in place.
